name: @aisha/acs-sdk
description: Agent Communication Standard SDK — the ONLY sanctioned way to create, sign, validate, send and receive inter-agent messages (docs/AGENT_COMMUNICATION_STANDARD.md, IP-2/IP-4). Envelope building (ULID ids, correlation/causation, intent anchor), Ed25519 signing, ajv validation against @aisha/acs-contracts, mode ladder off|shadow|warn|enforce, readback state machine for side effects, derivation provenance.
